{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Heal Trail}}''' - The '''Corrupted Blight Walker''' leaves a trail of puddles on the ground that last one second, which apply a short 0.1 second regeneration that heals any enemy that walks over them by 15 for its duration. }} ==Description== The '''Corrupted Blight Walker''' was a quick support enemy that appeared in the [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] and [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]]. It can currently only be accessed through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It leaves a trail of purple goo as it walks. Each puddle lasts a second and applies a 0.1 second long heal which regenerates 15 health. ==Appearance== The '''Corrupted Blight Walker''' has purple skin, with its appearance resembling that of an animal. It has four legs, large mouth and a tail. It wears purple shoulder-pads and a chestplate on its body, which also have small bones attached to it. It leaves a trail of purple goo as it walks. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Turret]] should be able to take care of this quite easily, due to their DPS. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can also be useful, due to their practically map-wide range. *Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]], [[Brawler]] or [[Cryomancer]] can be used to slow it down, as it is quite fast. **Multiple of these towers can also be used to drop its [[Defense]], though as it is quite low this will have minimal impact on the damage it receives. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CorruptedBlightWalkerRun.gif|Running animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCorruptedBlightWalker.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedBlightWalkerIconIG.png|'''Corrupted Blight Walker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Corrupted Blight Walker''' is a corrupted version of the [[Blight Walker]], except with its skull and spit ability removed. *The '''Corrupted Blight Walker''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
